svg.title: The atlas codes nine of the 11 state statutes in its log as moving the rules away from voters.
svg.desc: Ranked bars of the 64 entries in the atlas’s repair log by how each rule changed, split by the atlas’s direction code. Ballot initiatives lead with 17 entries, none away from voters; court rulings follow with 14; and nine of the 11 state statutes moved the rules away from voters. Set in Inter and Inter Tight. On a computer without both fonts, the labels fall back to another font and change width.
